column1: # 3GPP TS 36.413 S1AP PDUs that another implementation sent, captured on the wire in
# local lab runs on 2026-10-12 (tcpdump of SCTP in the network namespace of the core,
# which ran from its release sources). Each distinct PDU is here once:
# The procedures are attaches with sessions, detaches, service requests, S1 and X2
# handovers, and what a core answers to deliberately wrong messages. The subscribers are
# test values, 208-93 0000000001 to 0000000008 with the key of the sample configuration
# of PacketRusher: nothing here is of a real subscriber.
# The procedure code and the PDU alternative are read from the first two octets. The
# last column is what tshark 4.6.4 says the frame is, from which the first column has
# the name of the message, and `-` where tshark names none.
